issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation renders 'ει τεκνα του αβρααμ ητε τα εργα του αβρααμ εποιειτε' as a conditional statement ('Nếu... thì...'), but the Greek uses a rhetorical question/conditional structure ('If you are children of Abraham, do you do the works of Abraham?'). The Vietnamese omits the interrogative nature of the Greek 'εποιειτε' (do you do), making it a declarative statement of consequence rather than a challenge.
